item.description:
Dozer 5.0.1

A bug-fix release for 5.0.0. No new features; updating is recommended.

Fixed

  • A timer leak that made the app get slower the longer you used it. Every hide/show cycle started another 0.5s timer without stopping the previous one, and the run loop kept the old one alive forever. Each tick scans every on-screen window, so the cost stacked up with use. This is very likely the cause of the long-standing high-CPU and memory reports (upstream #211).
  • Removed three fatalError calls from the status-icon lookup that could crash the app when an icon was momentarily missing.
  • Icons could be selected or removed incorrectly: the lookup compared on-screen positions for equality, and an icon with no window reported a position of 0.
  • The menu bar height is now read live rather than cached for the process lifetime.
  • Sparkle's updater starts after the app finishes launching, as Sparkle expects.

Dozer 5.0.0

Modernization release. The minimum supported macOS is now 14.0 (Sonoma).

Fixed

  • Dozer no longer crashes on macOS 26 “Tahoe”.
  • Menu bar status items were assumed to be exactly 22pt tall; the menu bar is taller on current macOS, which broke auto-hide. The range is now derived from the live menu bar thickness.
  • Preferences could crash through recursive UserDefaults change handling.

Changed

  • Universal binary (Apple Silicon + Intel) instead of Intel-only.
  • Signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.
  • Dependencies migrated from Carthage to Swift Package Manager.
  • Sparkle 1.26 → 2.x; update checks now use this fork's feed.
  • MASShortcut replaced with KeyboardShortcuts.
  • Launch at login now uses SMAppService via LaunchAtLogin-Modern.
  • Defaults and Preferences updated to current releases.
